dialogues.content: "Who am I?"
Berry, I...
In my dreams that unfold like a double helix, I've asked myself that question countless times.
But up until now, there has been no answer. Only endless flowing quicksand covering my vision, and...
{性别:her|him}.
For the peace we once knew has been torn asunder by the vile claws of Filthoids...

This escape was heralded by that odd dream.
I've been plagued by similar ones all my life.

But now's not the time for reflection...
There's something more pressing at the moment—

Berry and I must flee from this isle known as "Purgatorio Island,"
where we spent our childhoods together.
Take it easy.
Watch your step.
You're not fully recovered. Are you sure you can do this?
I'm okay. It's just a few scratches.
Don't push yourself too hard. We still have to save some strength for those Filthoids.
You're not fully recovered. Are you sure you can do this?
I'm okay. It's just a few scratches.
Don't push yourself too hard. We still have to save some strength for those Filthoids.
(We're unarmed right now. We have to avoid those Filthoids as much as possible.)
(We're unarmed right now. We have to avoid those Filthoids as much as possible.)
Almost there. It's up ahead.
The village is in dead silence. I'm afraid they've probably...
...I mean, they've probably scarpered off by boat.
We should hurry home and get the weapons, and then get to the wharf. It's still dangerous here.
(We're unarmed right now. We have to avoid those Filthoids as much as possible.)
Almost there. It's up ahead.
Let's head to the wharf.
Ugh, they didn't even leave one single boat.
You were at the village when the Filthoids came, weren't you? If it wasn't for coming back for me, you could have escaped with them.
Don't be silly. You'd have done the same for me. Let's search along the shore and see if there's any old boats or something.
These are... Someone must have lost them when they ran away.
Hmm, take it. It's always good to be well-armed.
More Filthoids are coming...
Stay close, {nickname}. If necessary, give out the secret signals.
We made them up earlier so as not to alert the Filthoids up the mountain, remember?
Yes.
Alright, a quick check — Two pats on the right shoulder means...?
"Watch your back."
And two taps on the chest?
"Come closer."
And scraping on the nose?
"Everything's okay now."
Good. And the last one — three quick blinks?
...I forgot it.
Remember, three quick blinks means—
...I'm not interested in that signal, and I won't remember it anyway.
Let's head towards the top of the mountain. There used to be an airship there. If it's still around, we might be able to make it out.
So the key is... this sword?
Yes. Your sword was never meant to hurt.
Are these Filthoids... dead?
It seems someone had a fight with them just before we arrived.
Could it be one of the villagers... No, we were the first to open that door.
Anyway, thanks to that person, we don't have to deal with these Filthoids ourselves.
Whoever it was, they're not to be underestimated. We must be vigilant.
It seems someone used to live here.
This was your home, am I right, Berry?
...Yes, and no. It was OUR home.
Our home? But I don't remember a thing.
...It's okay. Maybe it's all for the best. After we make it out, we'll build a new home.
How many of them are there...
Let's get to the top to shake them off.
How come... it's them...
What happened, Berry?!
The Legion... They found their way here...
...Anyway, we gotta break out first!
They must be up to something.
A short distance away...
That is...
No. 0 is not supposed to release all her powers yet. Why...
No, that's not her power, it's Resonance.
...That brat she's trying to protect... That's the new receptacle for the Power of Resonance?
Come to think of it,  {性别:his|her} face was...
The reappearance of the "Power of Resonance" and "No. 0" together... What could this possibly mean...?
Give it up. It's over.
Give it up. It's over.
You're back, {nickname}... My other half, my reflection, and my echo.
You heard my voice and retrieved the power that belongs to you. The "Resonance."
This power didn't change anything. I fell into the sea and I'll never wake up again. It's all over.
No, I can see it — your future, our future... it doesn't end here.
Someone will pluck you from the briny waters and lead you to a frozen wilderness, where destiny will pose the ultimate test.
Are you saying... I'm still alive?
It's time to set off.

...{nickname}. Life is like a lonely cruise through the boundless darkness of the night. The river weeps, overflowing its banks, while the thorny thickets on either side stand as a testament to its sorrow.
I'll keep watching over you, The One Across the Shore... to see where you're going.
Within these flowing sands of memory, you shall find strength for your journey.
May they be your strength on your journey.
It's time to set off.

...{nickname}. Life is like a lonely cruise through the boundless darkness of the night. The river weeps, overflowing its banks, while the thorny thickets on either side stand as a testament to its sorrow.
I'll keep watching over you, The One Across the Shore... to see where you're going.
Berry, I...
Mmm. Alive and not incapacitated, no broken bones then.
Who are you...? How do you know my name? Berry, where are we—
No, we were...
(I must find Berry. If it weren't for me, she would've managed to escape from those soldiers...)
(Maybe...)
Hey, are you even listening? Camilla and <H>Snow</> have come all this way to save you! You better come with us to the city right now, or else you'll soon become a snack for some wandering Filthoids!
To... the city?
Got a fright, huh? No worries, you'll be safe in a jiffy — <H>Icelake</> is the largest city in northern Hyperborea!
Hyperborea... I'm in the Hyperborean Empire...?!
Well, yeah... What's the big deal?
Do you know this woman called Sibylle? Others refer to her as the "Chief," and she's supposed to be in this country... I need to find her.

Sibylle is a common name, but there's only one that's linked with the title "Chief." You want to find her? How did you lose your mind to the blizzard? I thought Charons are supposed to be resistant to cold temperatures.
I'm serious. She might've taken some...thing that's very important to me, so I must find her and get to the bottom of it.

Espionage, assassination, defiance... With what you've just said, the Imperial soldiers could just arrest you for these three reasons alone. If you really want to find the Chief, I'd advise you not to rush into it.
For the last time, if you don't want to end up as Filthoid fodder, come with us.
You seem to be all bruises and cuts, are you alright?
I'm fine. The pain's gone now.
Something really bad must've happened to you... But no worries!
You're under my wing now! Snow will protect you! After all, Snow is—
The city gate is just up ahead. Follow behind us, we'll get you in!
And keep your mouth shut. If anything comes up, our almighty Camilla will take care of it!
Okay.
Stop right there.
Ugh, not another check! Don't even remember Camilla and Snow, huh? Looks like your eyes and your brain aren't working very well.
Not you, Luno. I was talking to—
Oi, one-eye! In such a hurry to visit the Security Bureau for tea, eh?
You're not from here, are you? Where are you from? Got your travel permit?
Stop right there.
Ugh, not another check! Don't even remember Camilla and Snow, huh? Looks like your eyes and your brain aren't working very well.
Not you, Luno. I was talking to—
Oi, one-eye! In such a hurry to visit the Security Bureau for tea, eh?
You're not from here, are you? Where are you from? Got your travel permit?
(So... this is a "city"? Never seen or been to one before...)
(But I have no idea where to go... Guess I should find Snow and the lady called Camilla first.)
Seems like someone's had a bit of a mishap, and it's even attracted some Filthoids... Those nasty monsters!
Phew, thank goodness we took them down...
An excellent performance, I must say.
Don't cause any trouble in town, you hear me?
What exactly did you mean by "haunted house"?
I heard about it from the guests at The Asphodel. There's always someone complaining—
Like, even though it's such a big inn, the doors are always shut tight every day, turning away any travellers from outside the town...
Or how the lodgers seem to never ever leave, and sometimes, there's this really weird smell drifting from the inside of the house...
And how the innkeeper's face is colder than the waters of Lamenting Lake... It's as if he's not running an inn, but a coffin shop!
It doesn't sound too bad. I thought it was crammed with Filthoids and Sibylles.
But, if they don't welcome outsiders, I doubt if I can...
Still, it seems Ms Camilla Scarlet holds some sway here. Hmm... perhaps I could leverage her influence a little bit.
Nah, you can use Snow's name. From now on, you're under my wing, my little minion!
Thank you, but what's a "minion"?
It's what they call someone in those stories who's the favourite lackey of the awesome Demon King!
Among all the Luno in the world, why else would little ol' Snow have these nifty horns, if not to be a Demon King one day? It's totally my destiny!
And it was those mysterious voices that brought me to you, so you must be the minion sent by destiny!
Soooo~ I've made up my mind— with all my wisdom, I'm gonna guide you down the right path!
("<H>The Lunarians</> are generally friendly towards humans"... The books weren't lying.)
The inn's just up north! C'mon, fol—low—me!
(...It's just that this one seems a tad too friendly.)
Here we are! You wait here!
But just for one night. Come morning, you must go wherever you're supposed to.
...Understood.
Are you... a new lodger?
Just a penniless outsider looking for a place to stay, I was about to kick {性别:him|her} out.
An outsider? But... if you kick {性别:him|her} out, won't {性别:he|she} be homeless?
That's none of your concern.

But... the house is still unsold anyway, lending it to {性别:him|her} for one night wouldn't hurt, right? {性别:He|She} can pay you back when {性别:he|she} can, that way we get a little extra cash for basically nothing.
If you keep being so cold to everyone, you'll never find a buyer for that place.
You...
...Fine, have it your way then.
Ms Camilla Scarlet told me to come to this place. I was hoping to stay here for a few days, would that be possible?
No travel permit?
The house is to the south, follow me!
Here we are.
This room has just been cleaned up. You can stay here tonight.
Cool!
Don't be upset, Mr Henrik isn't really that greedy. It's just we've been quite strapped for cash lately, otherwise he wouldn't consider selling his old house to make ends meet.
It's been neglected for years, but after a good clean, it's not half bad, right? At least it keeps out the chill!
Oh, I haven't introduced myself. I'm Psyche, a lodger at the Hypnos' House. And sometimes I help Mr Henrik out.
(So much has happened... Weird dreams, that mysterious man in a white cloak, Sibylle, and "No. 0"... They all seem to be connected somehow, but I can't figure it out.)
(The only thing I'm certain of is that I've lost Berry...)
(...If she's managed to escape, she'd surely try everything to find me... Of course, I can't rule out the worst-case scenario that Sibylle has taken her to the Legion.)
(The silver lining is, it seemed that Sibylle <H>needed</> Berry for some reason, so she probably wouldn't harm her.)
(...Anyway, I need to scrape together some money in Icelake, get a travel permit, and then plan for my next move.)
I'm back.
You must be starving. Here's some freshly baked bread.
Berry...?
Are you all right?
I'm fine. Just so hungry that I accidentally bit my tongue. It hurts, so...
Then you better eat some bread and wash it down with warm milk, that'll make you feel better — be careful, don't bite your tongue again.
...Thank you, Psyche.
Are you sad?
...Hmm? Why?
I can feel it. Even though you're trying to put on a smile, you're not happy.
I'm a bit curious about what you've been through, but Mr Henrik told me not to pry into our guests' pasts.
Anyway... you can take a good rest here, and think about what to do next.
Thank you.
Psyche, I need to ask you something.
I need some money. Is there any place in the city where an outsider might find work without too many questions asked about their past?
Let me see...
Most people here work in the factories... Um, but they all ask to see a travel permit... Well, there's perhaps one place you could try—
Ms Camilla Scarlet's tavern, <H>The Asphodel</>. You can take up commissions with handsome rewards there.
But, those commissions are often quite dangerous... You might have to go to places even the local Escort would avoid, and you might encounter some wandering Filthoids...
Camilla Scarlet? I met her today. Though I had no idea that her tavern also runs this sort of business.
It's okay, I can handle it. Can you take me there?
Huh? After all this running around, you're going back to Camilla?
Then count Snow in! Snow's more than familiar with that place.
The Asphodel is just to the south.
Come on! Snow will be waiting for you in the square!
Your travel permit...
Are you deaf? Show me your... travel permit!
Sorry, sir, I'm a bit slow at this age, please bear with me for a moment...
Ah, here it is!
Huh...? Oh, is this you in the photo... you old codger?
Yes, sir...
How come it looks more like a mongrel to me, haha, hahaha!
Oi, why don't you give us a bark, huh?
...Let's leave.
There's something important you should know.
If you're from somewhere afar... Remember, whatever you do, never anger the <H>Solarians</>.
The "Solarians"...? You mean the ones without horns...? What's so special about them?
Or is it that, <H>WE</> are the special ones?
Yes. Here in Hyperborea, we, the <H>Charons</>, with our unique appearance, are different from the Solas. They even call us...
"<W>demon's children</>."
Ugh, speaking of which, Snow is super mad!

Whenever those humans talk about stuff like "demon's children" and "magic," they always give such dirty looks... just like when Camilla sees a drunken brawl in The Asphodel. But it's actually the "demon's children" who are being bullied by them!
Thank you, Snow.
But the fact remains — we are unwelcome here. So, be extra careful when dealing with Solas.
That soldier back there... Even after committing such a brutal act, the only consequence he will face is merely a demotion labeled as an "accidental mistake."
We've seen stuff like this many, many times... until everyone gets so used to it. Such things are commonplace in this place—

They are just as ordinary as the fact that Charons aren't allowed to enter the inner city of Icelake or leave the Empire. As ordinary as flowers withering, lakes freezing over, and snow melting in the hearth.
(...This makes returning to Purgatorio Island even more challenging.)
Why is it like this?
The Solas of Hyperborea believe that Charons who wield "magic" are evil sorcerers, the greatest threat to their peaceful lives.
But you can't always just suck it! Why not use your magic on them, and BOOM! Make them cry like babies! ...Ugh, seriously, it makes me so mad!
...Let's leave.
There's something important you should know.
If you're from somewhere afar... Remember, whatever you do, never anger the <H>Solarians</>.
The "Solarians"...? You mean the ones without horns...? What's so special about them?
Or is it that, <H>WE</> are the special ones?

"<W>demon's children</>."

Thank you, Snow.

They are just as ordinary as the fact that Charons aren't allowed to enter the inner city of Icelake or leave the Empire. As ordinary as flowers withering, lakes freezing over, and snow melting in the hearth.
(...This makes returning to Purgatorio Island even more challenging.)

The Solas of Hyperborea believe that Charons who wield "magic" are evil sorcerers, the greatest threat to their peaceful lives.
But you can't always just suck it! Why not use your magic on them, and BOOM! Make them cry like babies! ...Ugh, seriously, it makes me so mad!
It's you. And you're... the little girl from the Frey's? Psyche, isn't it?
Yes, Ms Camilla. I'm staying at the Hypnos' House for now.
...I see.
...I'm here with a friend. {性别:He|She} is looking for a job and wants to become a Phoxhunter.
Then you came to the right place! There's a commission for Phoxhunters right now—
Not now, Margie.
...Okay.
Already made friends... You're quite a charmer, aren't you? As for Phoxhunters—
Let's get one thing straight — this isn't child's play, nor an easy gig. It's TRUE that in this place, no one would probe into your past or background, but the rewards always come with risks.
It's you. And you're... the little girl from the Frey's? Psyche, isn't it?
Yes, Ms Camilla. I'm staying at the Hypnos' House for now.
...I see.
...I'm here with a friend. {性别:He|She} is looking for a job and wants to become a Phoxhunter.
Then you came to the right place! There's a commission for Phoxhunters right now—
Not now, Margie.
...Okay.
Already made friends... You're quite a charmer, aren't you? As for Phoxhunters—
Let's get one thing straight — this isn't child's play, nor an easy gig. It's TRUE that in this place, no one would probe into your past or background, but the rewards always come with risks.
She seems quite distressed; I can lend a hand too so we can get it back sooner.
No, this is a simple test just for a prospective Phoxhunter. If you don't have the chops for it, becoming a Phoxhunter would kill you.
Okay...
You'd really help me out? Aww... thank you!
That scoundrel headed west. But you know, Icelake is a maze of streets, so I can't be sure where he might have gone. Let's look for some clues first!
Hello, Mr Badi, out for a walk?
Oh, it's our little Princess Rubbish Bin! How's today's haul? I see you've got two little sidekicks to help you.
I'm not a sidekick! I'm the Demon King!
Okay, so... you are the "Demon King of Rubbish Bin" then?
Nuh-uh! It's the "Demon King of Light"!
Hahaha... let's not get hung up on titles for now... Mr Badi, did you happen to see a Charon man in a blue shirt with dark hair just now?

I think so... A young man just came barreling down the street — clumsy kid, wasn't even watching where he was going, headed straight for the rubbish bin in the Mist Aken! Wait, was he trying to poach on your turf?
Um, in a way! Thanks, I'm going after him.
Let's start by searching to the west.
The thief had dark hair, and was wearing... a blue top, I think.
Oh look! It's Mr Badi from the slums! Maybe he saw something.
So "Reticent Detective"... that's your title, Margie? Sounds cool... A bit short though — could use more punch!
Makes sense! Any suggestions, Demon King?
That old man back there called you "Princess Rubbish Bin"... That's a good one!
"Reticent Detective ☆ Princess Rubbish Bin", has a nice ring to it, doesn't it?
Argh—! Noooo way! Can we please drop that nickname? It's embarrassing!
Go get 'em! As the old saying goes, "Strike while the rubbish is hot!"
Check this out — two layers of crates against the wall. The bottom one is skewed, and there are messy footprints all over it — busted!
Ahem, according to the statement of Margie the Witness, she just straightened these crates when she did her "shopping" at Big Bin No. 3 this morning.
Thus, Margie the Reticent Detective deduces — that desperate thief must have stacked these crates to climb the wall! He's likely hiding on the rooftop right now!
Huh! Smart thinking! Let's get up there and check it out.
It's quiet around here.
...No worries! My detective instincts are telling me there's a clue nearby!
He meant Big Bin No. 3! Now come with me!
So "Reticent Detective"... that's your title, Margie? Sounds cool... A bit short though — could use more punch!
Makes sense! Any suggestions, Demon King?
That old man back there called you "Princess Rubbish Bin"... That's a good one!
"Reticent Detective ☆ Princess Rubbish Bin", has a nice ring to it, doesn't it?
Argh—! Noooo way! Can we please drop that nickname? It's embarrassing!
What, something in the bin?
Just making sure he wasn't hiding in—
Whoooa! Is that... half a bottle of wine and an antique pin!? Wow, aren't you the chosen one blessed by the gods of rubbish bins!?
But this really isn't the best time… just a sec!
(Margie fishes out two old newspapers from the rubbish, wraps her newly discovered treasures carefully, and stashes them in a corner.)
There, all set! I'll come back for these later. Finders keepers — I'll share this wine with you once we've caught the thief!
Um... I think I'll pass, thanks.
Is Icelake having a parkour race or something? With prizes for the fastest runner?
Hmm... you know what — I heard that a Luno elder did once set up a race like that...
Well then, you better hurry! The other contestant's been gone a good while.
So "Reticent Detective"... that's your title, Margie? Sounds cool... A bit short though — could use more punch!
Makes sense! Any suggestions, Demon King?
That old man back there called you "Princess Rubbish Bin"... That's a good one!
"Reticent Detective ☆ Princess Rubbish Bin", has a nice ring to it, doesn't it?
Argh—! Noooo way! Can we please drop that nickname? It's embarrassing!
Wha... Did you really have to chase me all the way up here? You said you were going to share the money with the poor anyway, so why can't I get a piece of it?
If you're hard up, I can help you. But you can't just grab money of people — that'll earn you a whack on the head with my shovel!
(The thief seems at a loss for words and jumps off the wall in frustration.)
Ah, there he is! On that roof!
He's disappeared again!? What is he, a ghost?
He must've ducked into the sewers!
Hold it right there!
Huff... Huff... Wait up... Not everyone is blessed with long legs, you know...
Over here, all the commissions for Phoxhunters are listed on this board!
Ah, hi Snow! Lending a hand to Phoxhunters again? What is it this time — Nabbed a few hundred bandits, thwarted a dozen dastardly schemes?
Today I'm keeping it low-key, just nabbed a petty thief.
Just one? That sounds almost believable, I've got to see this.
I've never fibbed before! Come here, my little minion. This is Mr Wells, the most hard-working Phoxhunter around here.
Hello, Mr Wells.
So it was you? Looking all neat and tidy, who'd have thought you had it in you?
Thanks, it was just a small thing.
A small thing? Let me tell you, it's all these small things that have turned Icelake into what it is now. If it was something big, Icelake would be turned upside down.
Then I should try harder, learn from professionals like you—
Learn from me? Give me a break! Take a good long think and figure out why you ended up on this path, this is what you should do.
I need money.
Who doesn't? I've got folks owing me a fortune! Being short's one thing, but I've never stooped to thieving or robbing.
That's great! Your first commission went smoother than I expected.
Go tell Camilla what drink you want, it's on me.
Your first gig was quite slick, and you got on with Wells. Your career as a Phoxhunter is off to a good start.
Here, a hot drink to warm you up. I was going to treat you to one, but since Wells has offered, we'll put it on his tab.
Right, I did mistake this {性别:lad|lass} for a thief, it's the least I can do.
Oh, and I can also catch {性别:him|her} up on our line of work. To be honest, it's been pretty tough lately, any commission worth a jot has to be fought for.
I just had a gander at today's jobs, and they're all thankless. Except for that hot potato...
Hold on, please!
Psyche? What are you doing here?
I thought I'd help show you the way. I mean... to Glevum Pit.
Snow knows the way! But... it's nice to have some company, especially when we're heading out of town.
Yeah, outsiders can easily lose their way out there. I saw you accepted Mr Henrik's... our request, so I thought I should help out.
Whoo... It's been a while since I've stepped out of the city.
The snow-draped conifers, the boundless lake... mountains with their peaks in the clouds... I love all this.
Snow's more a city soul! If only the outskirts were free of those roaming Filthoids.
It's safer inside, indeed. But there's something about the... air out here.
Is there a difference? All smells the same to me...
Mmm... The air in Icelake is always tinged with a scent of blood and echoes of weeping.
Out here, it's the scent of the forest and drifting ice, and the distant sound of steam whistles. Occasionally, you might catch a glimpse of snow-white deer darting through the trees—
While around Icelake's alleys, what darts out are thieves or bandits... and sometimes just whimpering beggars.
What about your hometown, {nickname}? Tell us about it! What's that island like?
The "air" is golden gravel and beachside rosemary...
It's misty sea fogs at midnight, and the massive Heaventree that Berr... my family and I used to gaze upon every day.
Mmm... if you ever make it back to your homeland, please send them my regards.
...Umm, you two are talking over my head...
You'll get it when you're older.
...But then again, Lunos never really grow older, do you?
The entrance to Glevum Pit is up ahead. Please be extra careful.
Thank you, you've been a tremendous help.
But you two should head back now. I can take it from here on my own.
...Umm... no way!
This Demon King can't just scarper from the battle and let the little minion think less of her. Psyche, you should also come with us!
Yep — come with the Demon King to clear out this monster's den! I bet you've never been on such an adventure, right? What a pity! Your life is certainly incomplete!
...Alright, I'm in.
It's locked? Watch me bash it open!
*Sound of headbutting the door*
...Ouchie!
A door this thick is probably impervious to brute force.
Then let's look around to see if there's another way in.
Snow, does your head hurt? Let me help you—
...There, a little puff to ease the pain.
Awww... you're so nice. When this Demon King conquers this place, I'll appoint you—
"The Gentle Green-Cloaked Mage, the Wise Master of Phoxene, the Inaugural Grand Duke of Glevum Pit"!
(I was the Duke of the Sewers... Is a grand duke a higher rank than a duke?)
(How come Psyche gets a higher title than me? Hold on, why am I seriously mulling this over again?)
"Guided by Snow the Demon King, the little minion who just arrived in Icelake from afar has become a brilliant Phoxhunter in a mere day."
A new chapter in the legend of this Demon King!
"Phoxhunter" is a cool name... Do they all hunt something called Phox?
Nah! Phoxhunters nowadays are actually bounty hunters. It has something to do with Phoxene a long time ago.
Right, I heard it used to refer to a profession that originated right here in Icelake.
It seemed to all start with the rich Heaventree veins in the Vidofnir Mountains, and the Phoxene on them could be sold for a good price...
Exactly! So, a long, long time ago, many people braved the risks of collecting Phoxene for money.
But then the big merchants and the Empire took over the mines around here, and ordinary folk hardly had a chance with Phoxene anymore...
After that, the local veins gradually ran dry, including this Glevum Pit...
Yeah, what a pity! Otherwise my little minion could have made a fortune selling Phoxene.
While Phoxhunters, who lived off commissions, remained as a profession. It's just that the types of commissions changed a lot since then.
There are big ones like protecting the city from the claws of Filthoids, and little ones like getting freshly baked bread back from a dog's mouth...
Fighting dogs for bread?
And some even more terrifying commissions like making sure a certain someone you don't like never shows up again...
But by the time you make a trip down to The Asphodel, wouldn't the bread have been gobbled up by the dog already?
You're both missing the point here!
Argh, those nasty yellow crystal spikes block our way!

While receiving aid from the Fischers, he deliberately concealed his condition. The 6th Legion's Escort intervened swiftly to suppress the chaos, but the damage was already done.

Is this it?

Uh... please tell me I'm not the only one who used to crawl into random places as a kid.

Little Minion! Mutt Ears! Quick, come here — Officer Fischer's awake!

(She looks peaceful. Were it not for the horrific wounds, one might mistake her for a girl lost in a tranquil dream — after all, she is so young, still at an age for dreams.)
Doesn't look like she's doing too well.
Eek! How come you walk like a cat? Not a single sound at all...
There you are, Outsider. Did you manage to report the situation about the poison to the inner city soldiers?

She will.

So she's not going to stay down for long. She'll drag herself back into the fight before the "Charon Hunt" case is resolved. For now, all we have to do is have a good rest and wait for her to wake up.
Rhythm... Rhythm!
Blues...? Keep it down... I'm so sleepy...

Uh... something about the Charons'... "sins"? Yes, what was that again?
Ugh, figures you've been slacking off in class again.
Hehe... working at night always leaves me too sleepy for school the next day... But hey, that's what I've got you for — my personal tutor!

*sigh* I had to work too, but you don't see me nodding off in class. We only get a few years of schooling... How can you just waste them like that? Anyway — the Charons' "sins." It all started from the <H>"Night of Lamenting Lake."</>

A thousand years ago, right here in Icelake, the horned "demons" — the Charons — pretended to join the Solarians for a lakeside festival. But that very night, they did something terrible... Nearly every Solarian there was slaughtered.
After that, the Charons started a war across Hyperborea, killing anyone they saw — until His Majesty Dis Galea, the merciful founder of the Empire, ended the bloodshed and restored peace.
That's why... for the crime of the "Night of Lamenting Lake", every Charon born since must carry the burden of that sin for the rest of their lives.
But... it's been so long. Do we really have to spend our whole lives paying for something we didn't do?
Yes. Repayment is all we can do... But if we join the Legion, become loyal soldiers of Hyperborea, or even earn the title of <H>Laurelled Charon</>... Maybe things could change for us then.
You'll make it, Blues! I believe in you!
Haha, with your faith in me, the 6th Legion's entrance tests don't seem so daunting anymore.
Well, let's wrap up today's Fischers Tutorial with a beautiful tune from my harmonica... Wait, where is it?
I told you to tie a strap or chain to it ages ago... But no, it was "too expensive" and "not worth it." ...Fine, I'll make one for you.
Blues... I'll do my best... I promise. We'll... get on the city walls... together...
How'd things go at the factory?
All sorted! With the 6th Legion's appointment letter, the factory owner doesn't dare push me around anymore.
Oh, how's it going with the Escort? Are you settling in alright?
Haha... Well, I'm just getting started, you know.

Nah, it's pointless. I'm way below the passing line on every test — hard work can't make up for everything.
But if I can make a difference in the Escort, I might still have a shot at becoming a Laurelled Charon, right? Plus, I can help the people of Icelake in the process.
Sure, it'd be great if we could pass together. But if I don't have what it takes, I won't force it — I'll just stumble my way through and see what works.
Rhythm, look over there — what do you see?
Um... a building?
Sure, but I mean the spot I'm pointing at — up there.
...The watchtower?
Exactly! More specifically, the light on top of the watchtower. That's the highest point of Icelake!
Every time I look at it from here, it feels so high, so far away, and so bright. Like a beacon from a storybook — right before my eyes, yet always out of reach.
But I'm not the same as before. I'm a Laurelled Charon now! Those dreams I had — performing, playing music — they're not just pipe dreams anymore!
Now I can get into the inner city, climb to the top of the watchtower, and stand under that light... It'll feel like I'm the king of Icelake!
"Soldiers, hear my command — full assault! For the glory of Hyperborea!"
Shh! Keep it down! Are you trying to get yourself into trouble!?
Ah, sorry, got a little carried away... Hehe.
Oh, the 6th Legion's training is no joke. The commander said the first three years will be intensive and completely residential, so I won't get to go home. If you miss me, just look at that light.
I'll be in the inner city waiting for you. I'll save every coin so we can finally live the good life. We'll watch operas, eat whatever we like... No one will push us around anymore.
Blues...
Aw, don't cry! It's okay, really. Three years will fly by before you know it! And hey, maybe you'll get lucky and become a Laurelled Charon next year!
Then we'll climb to the top of the city walls together and show everyone in Icelake just how amazing we are!
Mutt Ears totally called it! Officer Fischer's just as tough as our captain — practically unkillable!
It's you... I remember I was with Blu— No, wait... We were in the sewers... chasing...
The monster! The perpetrator of the "Charon Hunt" — did we catch it!?
Whoa, slow down. You've been unconscious for two days. Take a breath, have some water and eat something first.
I'll explain. That day, after they got you out of the sewer...
So... it got away after all... I—
Whoa, easy! Don't tell me you're thinking about diving back into that sewer. Your squad's already on it, and you're supposed to be resting. You're not going to help anyone in your condition.
Yeah. You've done everything you can. Let your colleagues take over from here.
I'm sorry for wasting your time. I haven't even been able to keep my promise to help you find your family...
Oh, right.
Here, take this. It's the key to my secret base. The address is written on the back. Could you go there and grab my silver seal with my name on it?
I'm in no condition to do much for you right now, but I can at least write a few letters to ask for help on your behalf.
Halt! This is the inner city. No Charons allowed in without special clearance!
Oh, it's you guys. Ease up — they just did the Escort a huge favour.
What brings you to the inner city?
We want to check on Officer Fischer and see if she's okay.
I heard she made it through, though she's still unconscious in the hospital. I can take you there. Just lay low and follow me.
This way, Little Minion!

Who here knows anything about opera?

The next day

With Blues's harmonica and that stranger's singing, I felt so happy I almost forgot we'd been thrown out that night.

Any chance this play's being performed again soon? Maybe we could stake out the theatre and see what happens.

An accident?

Now, Phoxhunters, here's your first task: take this list and head to the parking lot to find Clive for the weapons and ammo we'll need.

Ugh...

The 6th Legion... they use the title of "Laurelled Charon"... as a lure to deceive us.
LEAVE... the Legion.
Find a quiet, safe place... and take care of yourse—

Five Days Ago, Sewer Exit
It's all my fault. If I'd got here sooner, you wouldn't have been...

Or perhaps, like you said... my heart has already turned into... that of a monster.
If you're a monster... then what does that make me?
We chased so hard to catch the light, the dazzling light... only to find it's so... unreachable in the end.
If something is unreachable, why not pull it down to the ground?
Stay back — <H>his body is toxic</>... Who are you?

I'm here to extend an invitation. Join us. Drag the untouchable Solas down to the ground, and let them feel the wrath of Charons.
Don't rush to reject me. Reflect on what the Empire has done to you. They lured you in with sweet lies, broke you with merciless torture, and buried you under an ocean of despair.

Absolutely not! What awaits is a slow death — your bones picked clean by the Sola elites, hunted by traitors among our own kind, until you're discarded like trash in some forgotten corner.
With a single empty promise, they lure aspiring Charons like you and me straight into the abyss.

As long as the 6th Legion and the Alchemy Academy's web of lies remains intact, Charons of Icelake will continue walking this path to ruin, marching straight into the same tragedy as you... again and again.
The Empire stripped us of what we once had and left us trapped in this miserable present. Are we really going to let them crush everything we hold dear without putting up a fight?
Look at us. The Empire coveted our strength, shackled us like animals, and twisted us into grotesque monsters — into real demons.
But now, we've broken free of those chains. Isn't it time to turn their own weapons against them? Time we made them pay?

Let them tremble at the mere thought of us. Let them feel the pain we've endured. Make them never dare to covet what we hold dear again! Let them repent with their blood and remember us for eternity. Let the entire Empire scream our names in terror!
<W>The Forsakens</>...

You may call it vengeance, but I call it protection. We "demons" bear a duty to protect our kind. We'll rid the inner city of its "filth" and give your loved ones the cleaner, brighter future they deserve.

I still have... unfinished business.
Blues!
Do not follow.

Oh... it's you. Good morning.

Are you sure? Back then, Little Minion said it was too dangerous and wouldn't let me tag along. But after hearing what happened... I feel calling the situation "dangerous" was an understatement!
Rhythm...

This world is filled with countless things beyond our control. That's just how it is.
I see.
By the way, is this medal...?
Yes, the "Laurelled Charon" medal. Officer Lynn awarded it to me — for my "outstanding contributions" to the case.
Congratulations.

I still haven't found any concrete information about Berenica.

One month from now, the 13th Legion will be relocating a high-value prisoner by train from Icelake to Dismania, the imperial capital. The 6th Legion's been ordered to assist with the transport.

That matches what you've told me about Berenica. If it really is her, then <H>the train departing in a month</> might be your only chance.
(Could it be Berry? Has she... been taken to Icelake, just like me?)
Thank you for the intel. This is the only lead I have, so I'll give it a try no matter what.

As long as I'm alive, I'll eventually find a reason to keep going. Isn't that how it works?
I guess I'll see you around.
Welcome back. Would you like something to drink or eat first? The care package I prepared is in the cabinet to your left. A wide selection — I dare say there's something in there to suit your taste.
A punch in your face would suit my taste best.
Oh come on, I heard you were badly hurt and came to offer my regards.
Save it. I'm good as long as I'm still breathing. I'm not some coddled rich child like you.
That hurts... After all the effort I put into coming up with such a brilliant idea to net you the "big fish," this is the thanks I get?
*sigh* And here I was, dreaming that our ever-so-kind Miss Lynn would return with a heartfelt speech of gratitude for my genius.
..."Dear Officer Randy, thank you for your unmatched brilliance and flawless foresight." Happy now?

Jokes aside, while that "Raven" we were after ended up dead, the files we found on him led to a clean sweep of The Forsakens' influence in Icelake. Their plans to expand into the Cocytus Region? Dead in the water.

And you know what? Even the dead can serve a purpose. With the right timing, we could exploit this intel gap to sneak a few spies into The Forsakens. If it works out, this could be a real career boost for you, Lynn. Who knows? At this rate, you might even outrank me soon.
What's with the long face? Did you run into someone back home you owe money to or something?
Nothing, just tired. My head's killing me. I'm going back to get some sleep. Later.
Haha, finally! Been waiting for you to embrace the art of rest. Life lies in relaxation, you know. It's heartwarming to see my wisdom finally passed onto you. I'm so glad.
...Wait. There's one more thing.
There's more!? But I'm taking a vacation in—
Shut it. No vacation for you.
We found this slip of paper on Target No. 2. It's all wrinkled, covered in rambling nonsense.
These flowery words don't make sense to me. You look into it. Could be a hidden message we've missed.
Fine, let me see... "The silent silent snow, child of the sky..."
Huh. Sounds like poetry. Or maybe lyrics to some old song?
Chief Sibylle!
